calendarNotes: Fort Worth ISD’s 2026–27 traditional calendar starts August 10, 2026 and ends May 21, 2027. The amended PDF lists 175 student days, 78,750 instructional minutes, Fall Break on October 9, Thanksgiving Break from November 23–27, Winter Break from December 21 through January 1, a staff development day on January 4, spring break from March 15–19, Good Friday on March 26, and a staff development day on March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Which FWISD calendar should I use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use this page for FWISD’s traditional calendar. If your child attends an ADSY campus, Early College High School at TCC, Alice Carlson ALC, or Jo Kelly, use the corresponding calendar in Other Official FWISD Calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after winter and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return from winter break on Tuesday, January 5, 2027. After spring break, they return Monday, March 22, and have no school on March 26 and March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the ICS file update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import, so later FWISD calendar revisions will not appear automatically.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should I check for last-minute calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official Fort Worth ISD calendar page and your child’s school before making travel, child care, or campus-specific plans.

customSections.label: What Families Should Know
customSections.content:
Students have five consecutive days off in October. There is no school from Thursday, October 8, through Monday, October 12. October 8 is a staff day, October 9 is Fall Break, and October 12 is Indigenous Peoples’ Day.

Students return from winter break on Tuesday, January 5. Winter Break ends January 1, and January 4 is a staff day.

Another four-day weekend comes one week after spring break. Students have no school Friday, March 26, or Monday, March 29.

April has no districtwide holidays or staff days. The official calendar does mark STAAR testing and grading milestones during the month.

rows: The first day moves from August 12 to August 10.
Classes begin two days earlier than last year.
The calendar has 175 student days, up from 173.
The school year still ends May 21 despite the two additional student days.
FWISD added Fall Break on October 9.
Together with the October 8 staff day and October 12 holiday, students have five consecutive days off.
